covered: main document body text and field-marker token stream

checkedProperties: Accepting all tracked changes in the compared document yields the same normalized text as the revised document.
Rejecting all tracked changes in the compared document yields the same normalized text as the original document.
After accepting all tracked changes, Word field markers remain structurally valid.
After rejecting all tracked changes, Word field markers remain structurally valid.
The compared document does not place Word field markers inside deletion markup.

ecma376Traceability.claim: The parser recognizes the tracked-run wrappers that affect accept/reject text projection in the main document body.
For original, revised, and compared word/document.xml, the checker recognizes begin, separate, and end markers and requires a valid marker sequence after accepting and rejecting tracked changes.
The checker rejects field markers under deletion markup and requires deleted field-code text to stay under deletion markup.

knownUncheckedAreas: field instruction parsing, evaluation, and cached-result correctness, including PAGE and NUMPAGES semantics
